# cylinders_for_bonds { #mofography.visualize.cylinders_for_bonds }

```python
visualize.cylinders_for_bonds(
    bonds,
    ase_atoms,
    radius=0.25,
    bond_rgba_array=[127, 128, 129, 255],
    cylinder_resolution=15,
)
```

Build trimesh cylinder meshes for each bond pair in an ASE structure.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                     | Default    |
|-----------|--------|---------------------------------|------------|
| bonds     |        | a list of pairs of atom indices | _required_ |
| ase_atoms |        | an ASE atoms object             | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                |
|--------|--------|----------------------------|
|        |        | A list of trimesh objects. |
